t: This is the Piccadilly Theatre, a West End playhouse at the junction of Denman Street and Sherwood Street, close to Piccadilly Circus. It opened in 1928. The architect was Bertie Crewe, whose full name was William Robert Crewe. He was one of the leading English theatre architects during the building boom that ran from 1885 to 1915. The theatre came a little after that peak, but it carries the work of one of the best-known designers of that era.
